description: Lambda Function Environment Variable Contains a Potential Secret
rationale: A Lambda environment variable holds a literal value that matches a credential format (AWS keys, private keys, credentials in URLs, known token formats) or a literal value in a variable named like a password, secret, token or key. Environment variables are visible to anyone with lambda:GetFunction or lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration and are stored with the function version. Secrets Manager, SSM and KMS references are not flagged. The report shows only the variable name, detection type and a masked preview. Functions whose environment could not be read (Environment.Error) are UNKNOWN.
remediation: Move the value to Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and read it at runtime with the execution role, or use the AWS Parameters and Secrets Lambda Extension. Rotate the exposed credential and publish a new function version.
